name: Ranger: free Skinning leaves both primary profession slots for the Book of Artisans, and Skinning can be learned again
contract: Issue #10342: Ranger Skinning (8613) takes no primary profession slot (#8475/#8623), so a Ranger with Skinning
still has MaxPrimaryTradeSkill = 2 slots. The Craftsman's Codex re-derived the free slots at every login and
counted Skinning, so after a relog the Ranger had one slot: Herbalism from the Book of Artisans used it and
Apprentice Mining (2581) was no longer a row. The trainer also charged the Ranger's Skinning a slot, so after
unlearning it with both slots used Apprentice Skinning (8615) was not a row until the next login re-granted
8613 (playercreateinfo_spell_custom). Expected: after a relog with Skinning and Herbalism, Apprentice Mining is
available (0) and can be bought; with Herbalism and Mining, Apprentice Engineer (4039) is not a row (-1), while
Apprentice Skinning is available (0) right after Skinning is unlearned, can be bought, and leaves Apprentice

steps.label: Control: a Ranger with only Skinning can train Apprentice Herbalism
buy Apprentice Herbalism from the Book of Artisans
Regression (#10343): after a relog with Skinning and Herbalism, Apprentice Mining is available
buy Apprentice Mining from the Book of Artisans
Mining was learned as the second primary profession
Control: with Herbalism and Mining, Apprentice Engineer is not a row
DISCRIMINATING: with both slots used the Ranger can train Apprentice Skinning again before the next login
buy Apprentice Skinning from the Book of Artisans
Skinning took no slot: Apprentice Engineer is still not a row
